name: Report Software
description: Software for creating reports for most trade requirements - industry compliant and up-to-date. Create your own reports using the report template editor. Add your logo and accreditations.
long_description:
Report Software is a comprehensive tool for creating industry-compliant reports for most trade requirements. Features include:

• Custom report template editor - design reports to your exact specifications
• Add your company logo and accreditations
• Fire safety certificates (BS5839-1, BS5839-6, BS5266)
• Electrical installation condition reports (EICR)
• Fire extinguisher and dry riser inspection reports
• PDF generation and digital signatures
• Client and job sync with ServiceM8
• Automatic certificate attachment to ServiceM8 jobs

Stay industry-compliant with always up-to-date report templates.
